gates.evidenceAndLimitations: Cross-origin frame parent-DOM access failed; 100 forged/oversized message attempts found no native channel. gates.evidenceAndLimitations: With both OS permissions authorized for the disposable app, the origin-labelled Vezham prompt appeared and explicit Deny returned NotAllowedError/no stream: 4/4 final-request checks passed. An earlier request chose Allow in the app prompt but the denial-only guard returned Deny; its original 3/4 result is retained separately. Targeted OS resets succeeded after app closure and the build was removed. Real website grants, persistence/revocation and separate device cases remain unverified.
gates.name: Native permissions and revocation
gates.nextDependency: Native denial is verified. Complete actual website grants, persistence/revocation and independent device cases only within separately authorized scope.

Cross-volume saves, overwrite completion, symlinks, metadata/quarantine, and abrupt-host-death cleanup still need validation.
gates.name: File upload/download security
gates.nextDependency: Validate remaining destination/metadata/lifetime cases before production transfer acceptance.

gates.evidenceAndLimitations: The current 14-check find/zoom API regression passed. The AppKit prototype does not expose every find option or clear/stop/reset UI; durable browser history and crash behavior are not implemented/verified.
gates.name: Find and zoom behavior
gates.nextDependency: Validate the complete product UI/history behavior after engine approval.

gates.evidenceAndLimitations: 30/30 uniquely attributed single-view content-process terminations recovered; 7 checks per run. Signal-to-result observed p95 upper bound 600.71 ms; callback-to-DOM p95 502.09 ms. Those timings used a hidden automatic-reload fixture before the recovery-state fix. The final revision passed 49/49 checks in actual AppKit windows across Profile A, Profile B and Private: recovery status, no automatic reload, real toolbar Reload, last committed URL, new document identity and unchanged synthetic storage/documents in unaffected windows. Five injected stale navigation callbacks were rejected before and after reload; foreign-view callbacks were also rejected. This tests native callback injection, not arbitrary event scheduling or stale process notifications. A stale-callback defect was fixed with retired-navigation/active-navigation identity checks, view ownership checks, retained committed URL and explicit user reload. Remaining gaps include durable product state, termination during navigation/download/profile switching and broader crash scheduling. Helper attribution used read-only private Darwin coalition/unique-ID diagnostics, validated against two simultaneous isolated apps with disjoint helper groups. Exact executable paths, process owner and both coalition IDs were checked; unique IDs were rechecked immediately before each targeted signal. The diagnostic stays outside browser source and is not a stable public product API.
gates.name: Crash and content-process recovery
gates.nextDependency: Validate in-flight navigation/download/profile-switch crashes, durable state and broader process-callback scheduling; retain host-specific diagnostic limits.

gates.evidenceAndLimitations: Compilation, ad-hoc signature verification, signed normal entitlements, launch, and executed local/public tests succeeded with App Sandbox and Hardened Runtime. The normal bundle has no media entitlement/purpose string. Developer ID, distribution enforcement, and macOS 26 runtime remain unverified and scheduled for final release validation.
gates.name: Sandbox and Hardened Runtime compatibility
gates.nextDependency: Complete signing/notarization and minimum-OS validation in the final release-validation stage.

gates.evidenceAndLimitations: All 7 public destinations loaded in 3 fresh-store repetitions: 21/21 HTTP landing-page observations. No login, editing/save workflow, payment, conference room, or service account was used.
gates.name: Representative website compatibility
gates.nextDependency: Run approved critical account workflows if the public-only scope changes.

gates.evidenceAndLimitations: Targets were approved. 30 AC-powered timing samples met the 3 measured proxy thresholds; an earlier 30-sample battery run was retained separately. The prior host-specific diagnostic measured bounded recovery and aggregate RSS before the recovery-state fix; those values were not requalified for the changed revision. True OS cold launch, energy/conference and controlled clean-state validation remain open. A separate AC-powered ten-view run idled 630.01 s, then collected 30 one-second host+12-helper RSS samples. Peak 23.77 MiB against the 1.5 GB target; numeric threshold met. RSS excludes compressed-memory/physical-footprint accounting. This is one idle run with sequential samples, hidden windows and an active desktop.
gates.name: Performance targets
gates.nextDependency: Complete the remaining method-controlled cold-launch, energy, conferencing and product-performance measurements.

gates.evidenceAndLimitations: The user scheduled developer code signing/notarization for the final stage. No notarized distribution, installer/updater, or signed metadata run occurred.
gates.name: Internal distribution feasibility

latestAttributedChecks.crashEvidenceProvenance: Copied without changing raw sample run IDs after the first idle observation was interrupted to allow timer coalescing. Native source hashes match.

crashRecovery.limitations: Single hidden private fixture, automatic reload. Does not validate visible recovery UI, multi-view/stale callbacks, user recovery choice, host/GPU/network-process crashes, or durable product state.

latestAttributedChecks.method: Host-specific private Darwin coalition/unique-ID diagnostics outside app source; exact path, owner and identity checks. Active desktop; hidden AppKit windows; OS caches untouched.
latestAttributedChecks.security: Normal App Sandbox/network-client/user-selected-file entitlements and Hardened Runtime; no debug/media entitlements. No root or security relaxation.

tenIdleViewsMemory.limitations: RSS only, not physical footprint/compressed-memory accounting. Hidden windows and active desktop; no true cold-cache, energy or conferencing acceptance. One 10-minute run; 30 sequential samples are not 30 independent runs.

latestAttributedDerivedStatistics.method: Recomputed from raw native results, per-signal guards and per-process RSS snapshots. Sample variance uses n-1. Sequential idle samples are not independent idle runs.
latestAttributedDerivedStatistics.revisionScope: Metrics describe the recorded measured source. Later prototype changes require separate validation; no current performance qualification is inferred.

latestRecoveryRegression.method: One isolated normal-entitlement build; sequential fresh LaunchServices processes; loopback only. Foundation URL policy is a separate executable.

latestRecoveryUI.limitations: Actual prototype windows/toolbar; three targeted content terminations; native test-only callback injection. Synthetic storage only; no durable product history or host-crash restoration claim.
